description.value: Whole Foods Market in West Vancouver is a large natural and organic supermarket carrying a wide selection of organic produce, sustainable seafood, and specialty grocery items. The store houses multiple in-house eateries including a coffee bar, pizza counter, burrito bar, juice bar, made-to-order sandwich counter, and a sushi bar, making it a convenient one-stop resupply point. As an Amazon-affiliated location, it also offers grocery pickup and delivery for Prime members.
